scope: explicit Europe/London autumn-fold policy for deterministic session detection

policies.first: include only datetime.fold=0 for ambiguous local wall-clock bars
policies.second: include only datetime.fold=1 for ambiguous local wall-clock bars
policies.reject: raise ChartIntelligenceError for an observed ambiguous in-session local time

validation.focused_command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run pytest -q tests/test_chart_intelligence.py tests/test_chart_intelligence_stress.py
validation.integration_command: PYTHONPATH=. uv run pytest -q tests/test_chart_intelligence.py tests/test_chart_intelligence_stress.py tests/test_chart_overlay_contract.py tests/test_chart_renderer_contract.py tests/test_chart_ai_contract.py

remaining_limits: bars that skip the entire repeated hour cannot expose an unobserved ambiguity
renderer and alert integration remain separate gates
